dimensions.note: Draws the human/assisted boundary around a function (reporting, sourcing, editorial judgement, verification stay human) rather than around a tool. Useful structural move for register decisions elsewhere in this system.
dimensions.evidence: catalog observation: 'Draws the human line around a function rather than a tool ... Confirms verification and polish as structurally different activities.'

dimensions.note: The staffing model behind the AP standard assumes a multi-desk newsroom. Copying that structure into a single-author publication would be imitating an org chart this system does not have.
dimensions.evidence: catalog observation: 'The staffing model behind it does not transfer to a single-author publication.'

dimensions.note: This record studies a paraphrased secondary account, not the AP standard's own citation practice; no craft evidence about citation behaviour to carry forward.

strengths: Names a defensible human/assisted boundary by function rather than by tool, which transfers cleanly to a Skill's authority.may_not list.
weaknesses: Institutional multi-desk staffing context does not transfer to a single-author publication.
notes: See editorial/voice.md for the voice vocabulary this evaluation deliberately does not restate.
